definition: Total revenue as the company itself totals it on the income statement.
Operating income as reported. Not reported by banks and some others.

Net income attributable to the parent company. Where a company does not tag that, net income available to common shareholders, then net income including noncontrolling interests; the tag used is recorded with every value.
Diluted earnings per share as reported (not adjusted for later stock splits).
Total liabilities, only where the company reports the total itself.
Equity attributable to the parent company's shareholders. Where a company only tags total equity including noncontrolling interests, that is used and recorded.
Cash and cash equivalents on the balance sheet, excluding restricted cash. Where a company only tags the total including restricted cash, that is used and recorded.
Net cash from operating activities. Where a company only tags the continuing-operations figure, that is used and recorded.
Cash paid for property, plant and equipment, as a positive number. Not mapped for banks and real estate companies, which do not report it this way.
Net income available to common shareholders: net income attributable to the parent company minus preferred dividends and similar amounts.
